issues.description: Method parameter name mismatch for GroverKakuro.state_preparation: the template implementation (template_repository/ex5_grover_kakuro.py) declares the third parameter as 'ancilla_register' while the class __init__ and the reference solution (solution_repository/ex5_grover_kakuro.py) use the name 'auxiliary_register' for the same conceptual register. This inconsistent identifier for the same auxiliary/ancilla qubit register may confuse students when they map the problem description, class attributes, and method signatures to the reference implementation and tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Rename the parameter 'ancilla_register' in the template GroverKakuro.state_preparation signature to 'auxiliary_register' (and update any occurrences in the template docstring/body) so the template matches the terminology used in the class __init__, the problem statement, and the solution. This keeps naming consistent and avoids student confusion between the terms 'ancilla' and 'auxiliary'.
